work_packages.title: Source diagnostic and adjudicated reference set
work_packages.dependency_qualification: lawful collection scope and WP01 definitions; can proceed alongside contract implementation using research-only records.
work_packages.actions: freeze the 120-issuer diagnostic before viewing vendor outputs: five primary-listing strata of 24 issuers each, six sectors × four issuers per stratum. International comprises eight UK, eight Japan and eight EU issuers. Resolve dual listings to one issuer. Freeze selection date, capitalization categories, issuer identifiers and selected sources; do not select only easy disclosed pairs.
work_packages.acceptance: source-linked reference set, annotation instructions, disagreement record, fixed denominators and limitations. Report conditional adjudicated precision, verified-support yield, unknown rate and recall only within the defined reference set. Do not call this global recall or production-grade precision proof.
work_packages.rollback: stop a source route that lacks permission; keep permissible research notes and unresolved status.
work_packages.planning_effort: a hypothetical 30–90 minutes per issuer plus 15–30 hours adjudication gives approximately 75–210 analyst hours. Complexity may require a revised estimate after the first 12 cases. These estimates are not measured throughput.
work_packages.specification_markdown:
**Custody:** incumbent research/source owners; independent reviewers.

**Dependencies:** lawful collection scope and WP01 definitions; can proceed alongside contract implementation using research-only records.

**Actions:** freeze the 120-issuer diagnostic before viewing vendor outputs: five primary-listing strata of 24 issuers each, six sectors × four issuers per stratum. International comprises eight UK, eight Japan and eight EU issuers. Resolve dual listings to one issuer. Freeze selection date, capitalization categories, issuer identifiers and selected sources; do not select only easy disclosed pairs.

For each issuer, record documents attempted, actual availability, named and anonymous relationships, role specificity, time precision, magnitude availability, source rights and source-selection bias. Independently adjudicate 30 difficult cases. Record unresolved cases instead of inventing truth.

**Acceptance:** source-linked reference set, annotation instructions, disagreement record, fixed denominators and limitations. Report conditional adjudicated precision, verified-support yield, unknown rate and recall only within the defined reference set. Do not call this global recall or production-grade precision proof.

**Planning effort:** a hypothetical 30–90 minutes per issuer plus 15–30 hours adjudication gives approximately 75–210 analyst hours. Complexity may require a revised estimate after the first 12 cases. These estimates are not measured throughput.

**Rollback:** stop a source route that lacks permission; keep permissible research notes and unresolved status.

work_packages.title: Operating-outcome experiment
work_packages.custody: existing research/evaluation and relevant operating-data owners; independent reviewer.
work_packages.dependency_qualification: lawful frozen data, WP04 replay proof, WP05 quality, WP06 mechanisms.
work_packages.actions: choose one primary operating target and horizon, freeze its event universe and label policy, estimate independent event/time-block count and minimum detectable improvement, then preregister baselines and nulls. Run direct-link, nongraph same-information, macro/industry and appropriate IO alternatives before a neural challenger.
work_packages.acceptance: the full economic-evidence protocol. Show missingness, uncertainty, costs, coverage and failed hypotheses. Compare true paths with type/direction/layer/rewired controls. If the test cannot distinguish practical improvement, report inconclusive instead of “validated.”
work_packages.rollback: retain evidence product if predictive gain fails. No authority automatically increases.
work_packages.planning_effort: 10–20 data-science days plus 2–5 review days after usable data exists. Obtaining historical vintages or observing future outcomes is a separate elapsed-time constraint.

work_packages.title: Optional neural challenger
work_packages.custody: incumbent research/model owner; same independent evaluation boundary.
work_packages.dependency_qualification: WP08 demonstrates a tractable target and adequate eligible data; explicit lawful training/evaluation rights.
work_packages.actions: begin with a small typed relational model and a matched information budget. Add heterogeneous attention or temporal memory only for a measured deficiency. Freeze candidate pools and state by cutoff; distinguish undisclosed from negative edges. Audit pretrained-representation contamination and model lineage.
work_packages.acceptance: useful improvement over the best same-information non-neural comparator, uncertainty beyond the precommitted practical hurdle, calibration/coverage stability, source/region robustness, acceptable cost and prospective evidence. Preserve all existing kills.
work_packages.rollback: reject the added complexity if its benefit is unproven, fragile, rights-incompatible or uneconomic. Do not rename a failed model into an accepted graph score.
work_packages.planning_effort: 10–20 data-science days for an initial challenger after data readiness. No prospective validation period is promised in advance.
